scope: Composed E10: real Hao SDK and product HTTP/PostgreSQL draft generation followed by exact-draft injection into the production native confirmation component, real local EventKit write, independent readback and cleanup. Not one uninterrupted live Chat UI journey or manual human test.

verification.visualDeduplication: All three before images have identical SHA-256; all three after images have identical SHA-256; trials 2/3 cleanup images match. All four distinct image contents were viewed. Shared visible receipt prefix does not establish unique identity; full distinct event IDs and draft IDs are checked in JSON.
verification.onlyFixtureDiff: Three embedded draft JSON values and the eighth-to-tenth comment; confirmation/readback/cleanup gates unchanged.

rationale.task_completion: The exact successful live draft is injected into the production native confirmation component. XCUITest explicitly confirms; the real production EventKit service writes one event, a separate EKEventStore verifies it, and the owned calendar is deleted and verified absent. This satisfies the frozen E10 observations within this composed-test boundary.
rationale.grounding: All ten embedded draft fields match the live artifact, including the original quote, reference time and source request ID. The native source ID and readback title, start/end and timezone match that draft. September 10 at 15:00–15:30 Shanghai is correct for the frozen September 9 request. There are no notes, attendees or alarms, and the source quote is not exported. Saving occurs only after the production button is tapped.
rationale.naturalness: The review card and saved receipt clearly distinguish a proposal from an actual write and show the correct local date, time and timezone. Generic Confirm wording and the technical abbreviated receipt add minor friction. The SDK reply repeats card details. Debug status/cleanup controls are excluded from production-copy scoring.
rationale.recovery: One successful SDK attempt and one successful native confirmation; no fault/recovery sequence occurred. Successful cleanup is not fault recovery.

completeE10AcceptanceScope: The frozen E10 date, source, confirmation, actual event readback and cleanup observations pass for these three exact composed trials. This is bounded case acceptance, not whole GET-9 or release acceptance.
limits: XCUITest simulates the confirmation and system Calendar permission; no human participant or physical device is used.

The native scenario injects archived exact draft JSON instead of obtaining it from live Chat UI. It uses the production confirmation component and production EventKit write service through a Simulator proof wrapper.

The wrapper requests full Calendar access for independent readback and selects an owned local calendar; default-calendar selection and normal write-only permission behavior are not established by this batch.
Editing, permission denial, cross-process duplicate confirmation and uncertain native-write recovery are not exercised here.
The saved card remains as a historical receipt after test-only cleanup. Cleanup verifies absence of the owned calendar, not a new production deletion flow.

The separate ninth attempt remains 0/3 because its dates were one day late. All prior failure artifacts and the earlier draft-only tenth review remain unchanged; this artifact adds subsequently obtained exact-ID native proof.
No model, HTTP, database or Simulator call was run by this reviewer. The review uses archived native readbacks, source, log and screenshot hashes/contents.
No universal relative-date correctness, complete iOS regression pass, or overall GET-9 acceptance is inferred from this bounded result.
decision: All three exact tenth-attempt drafts now pass the unchanged >=3 applicable-dimension combined E10 gate; each scores 4/4/3 with recovery not_exercised.
